001: Did you just move? What is your new apartment like?
It's a pretty spacious apartment, with two bedrooms and a large living room.
That's great! And the neighborhood where you live, is it quiet?
Yes, it's very calm and there's a market right next to the house.
How nice! It must be very practical for everyday life.
Definitely! And the best part is that it's close to my work.
002: What is your parents' house like?
It's a simple house, but very cozy, with a big backyard.
That's nice! And how many bedrooms does it have?
It has three bedrooms and a pretty spacious kitchen.
It is! On the weekends there's always someone at home.
003: Do you like your new room?
I like it a lot! It's bright, airy, and has a nice view.
How wonderful! And is the bed comfortable?
It is, I bought a new mattress last week.
Great! Sleeping well makes all the difference.
True! Now I wake up much more refreshed.
004: What is the kitchen in your house like?
It's small, but it has everything I need.
And do you usually cook at home?
Yes, I like to prepare my own food.
How nice! What do you like to make the most?
I love making pasta and also some really fluffy rice.
005: Does your apartment have a balcony?
It does! It's small, but there's room for a table and two chairs.
How lovely! It must be great for having breakfast.
It really is! Especially when the day is sunny.
And can you see the sunset from there?
Yes, I can! It's one of my favorite parts of the day.
006: Do you live alone or with someone else?
I live with a friend; we share a two-bedroom apartment.
And do you get along well with the household routine?
We get along great! Each one takes care of their part.
That's good! Sharing a house can be complicated.
It can, but with communication everything gets easier.
007: What is the decoration in your living room like?
It's pretty simple, with a gray sofa and some plants.
That's nice! Plants make the space more lively.
I agree! They bring good energy to the place.
And do you have any painting on the wall?
I have a big painting that I got from my mother.
008: Does your building have a leisure area?
It does! There's a pool, a gym, and a barbecue grill.
Wow, lucky you! Do you use it a lot?
I use the gym almost every day, and the pool in the summer.
And the barbecue grill, have you used it?
I have! Last month I had a barbecue with my friends.
009: Is your house far from downtown?
No, it's pretty close; you can walk there in ten minutes.
That's great! And is public transportation good there?
It's decent; there are buses and a taxi stand on the corner.
That's good! It makes life much easier.
Definitely! I don't need to rely on a car for anything.
010: Do you plan to move someday?
I do; I want to buy a house with a backyard for my daughters.
That's a beautiful plan! And where would you like to live?
I dream of a house in a more remote neighborhood, with more greenery.
That must be great for raising kids.
That's what I think! I want them to grow up with room to play.
